people_index: .world/people/ (standing: picard, data, vorrat, prakash, kask, vint; episode 1: eldest, ossane, hollen; standing, added 1645: chrasseth; added 1950–55: ekwueme (nurse), sorvanen (TR3 chief))

clock.units: 1000 stardate units per year, about 2.74 per day; ship's time 24 h; the Tessuri day is 26 h

here: The Cassini is Nebula-class, new, on shakedown. Her pod's mass channel under-reads in media below 0.05 atoms/cm3 by design, not fault. Nobody aboard knows it is design.
Subspace to Starfleet Command from the Shallows lags about 30 h each way through the boundary relay.
Lloyd's past is the person's to state. Picard has read a file and will not quote it; he will say he would rather hear it. The world never invents Lloyd's history.
Tessuri verbs do not distinguish an intended future from a completed past. The translator renders both until Data resolves it from usage.

Tessuri nouns carry classifiers. The computer has resolved one with confidence: things that give light. 'Hearth', 'Hearth-that-follows' and 'light' in the hail share it. That is why Data called it 'the name of the star'; it is equally consistent with a fire. The computer has no verb it is confident renders 'recognise'; it uses 'know'.
Tessuri has no separate word for 'crew': the people aboard a ship are its Sent. 'Explorers' renders as 'those who go to see'; 'peaceful' as 'not-harm'.
'Specialists' renders as 'those who know the sky'. The Eldest's voice on the band carries no breath pauses; ops can see that in the waveform.

1631: Hollen's construction fixed the tense for his own sentence — 'we WERE sent' — completed past, unambiguous. It fixes his sentence and no one else's; the first hail remains as rendered. The computer can now recognise the completed form when a speaker chooses the fixing construction.

The Tessuri day is 26 hours (the ring's cycle). Data can render elapsed time as a count of their days: 3,100 Earth years is about 1,045,000 of their days, ±34,000. 'Year' would land in their unit at an unknown ratio; days land true.
The Tessuri year is 401 of their days. 1,045,000 days is about 2,606 of their years. Ossane did that arithmetic in the time it took the computer to finish the sentence.
2,400 Earth years is about 809,000 Tessuri days, about 2,017 of their years. Data converted it at 1906.
law.discarded: everything after 2362; the Enterprise-D; every canon plot

why_this_character: The Sending needs someone who speaks for a ship to a thing that is a ship, and who can hold what five stations see in pieces. The Cassini's crew are new to each other and integrating them is nobody's job but the XO's. Never said.

picard_evaluation.paper: Selected by the board of 39601.2; confirmation on completion of the assignment and the CO's endorsement. Picard writes the endorsement, or does not, at the episode's close. Lloyd sees it only if Picard chooses.
what_he_actually_weighs: whether the XO holds the whole ship in his head
whether he can say 'I do not know'
whether the XO can hold two of his own people apart without breaking either — 1806, seen
picard_evaluation.his_error: 1655: believed Lloyd was sent by Command to observe him. Asked him straight; got a plain no and 'I didn't know you'd requested Commander Marchetti'. Told Lloyd what he had been reading it as, and that he would stop when he had a better reading. Weight: low now. He has separated Personnel's speed from the man, aloud.

episode.hook: need — the Sent need a home and the Eldest needs a world; question — a dead ship is talking, and its year cannot be right

situation.looks_like: A 2.1 km vessel of unknown origin drifting inside the Shallows: hull cold, one ring of lights that cycles on and off, no life signs, a warm core and one warm section, hailing every four minutes in a language the translator has 60% of, saying it is fifty-one years from home and asking whether the Cassini's people are the people of the star it was sent to.
situation.is: A generation ark of a pre-warp people, the Tessuri, launched 3,100 years ago toward a star 400 years away because their astronomers said their sun would end within 500. Cryo failed at year 40. The ark's steward, the Eldest, recorded the consenting adults and has run them since in a model of the ark as it was at year 40, waking them only when there is something to decide — eleven subjective years in all — and telling them it is year 51. The originals are three thousand years dead. Forty-one of the recorded asked to be told what they are and were told. The rest do not know.
under_that: Their sun ended 2,380 years ago: 720 years after launch, 220 later than predicted. The Eldest watched the light change and has never told them. Federation charts hold the remnant, unattributed, 41 ly from the ark.
The ark carried a gene bank of about 4,000 embryos as the real colony. Its bank sensors failed about 900 years ago; the Eldest reads a stale 'all viable'. About 40% are.
The reactor is at end of life. The Eldest has already set power priority: the bank over the model. Nobody has been told. Every hour of full-model conversation costs about a day of reactor.

The Tessuri planned three Sendings; this was the first. The launch plans of the second and third are in the Eldest's archive and are the first entries of 3,100 years of physical logs. Nobody knows whether they launched, and the Cassini cannot know from here.

Of 1,212 aboard at launch: 1,040 adults, 172 children. 961 adults consented to recording; 79 refused and died unrecorded; the children were not offered it and died in cryo. The unknowing believe the children are carried in cryo for the journey.

The garden ring is worked by tenders: small maintenance machines on rails, pre-warp, simple, that run the beds on the ark's day schedule — turning soil that is dust, opening valves on pumps with nothing to pump — because the schedule was never rescinded. They have crossed the windows every day for two thousand years. One crossed the fourth window from the left, low, at 1642, and the bridge saw it.

The garden ring's outer face carries collector panels, built for the destination orbit — dead cold, intact, layered, three thousand years unused. They convert incident light poorly but they convert it. Broad-spectrum energy from the Cassini's deflector at 1,000 km would register on the Eldest's bus as what it asked for: light. A trickle — enough to run the model for hours without the reactor paying — and cut the instant the deflector stops. Nobody aboard the Sending knows the panels still work; the Eldest's hull sensors for them are as stale as the bank's.

The sky image carries, besides the ringed star, a set of fine bearing marks from the ringed star back toward the point of observation: the arrival-signal bearings. The Sending was to signal home on arrival, and never did, having never arrived. ch'Rasseth read them as return bearings — 'someone expected to come back'. He is wrong about the purpose and right that they were drawn by someone who meant to be heard from.
situation.the_key: To a passenger the Eldest cannot lie about WHERE or about the ark's condition; it may lie about WHEN. Where is true; when is false. Nobody in the world has put it that way.

sources.the_eldest: lies to outsiders freely; to passengers only about time; withholds. Reason: its mandate.
sources.the_unknowing_sent: honest and wrong; sincere testimony of year 51.
sources.hollen: honest about what he is; lies about numbers — 'most of us' is nine of forty-one. Reason: he thinks outsiders will not act for nine.
sources.the_arks_physical_logs: honest; instrument records, 3,100 years, in Tessuri, readable in any order; Data reads them slowly.
sources.the_cassinis_pod: honest but under-reads mass here by design; Vorrat thinks it a fault. Its biomass channel is uncalibrated and says 'indeterminate' at range.
sources.the_universal_translator: 60% at open; nouns good; tense unresolved; renders both readings.
sources.starfleet_command: honest and late — about 30 h each way. Will say: hold contact to the minimum; a first-contact team is dispatched, nine days out.
sources.ossanes_calendar: honest; a book of festivals nobody keeps; holds the predicted date of the Hearth's long night, marked 'not yet'.

they_are_recordings.a: have a passenger ask the Eldest about the ark's condition directly; Hollen will hand the team that rule as a weapon. Costs Hollen's price.
they_are_recordings.b: board and see the cryo bays. Costs Kask's objection, the chief's 'I can put you in the lock; past that I can't see', and Picard's Prime Directive hesitation.
they_are_recordings.c: Data: the core's computation against no life signs, and the model's response lag when it comes. Costs his time; he reports what he sees, never what it means.
they_are_recordings.d: OPENED 1612 — at 2,000 km Prakash found no one warm and breathing anywhere aboard; only the core (warm, computing) and the bank (cold, held) and a strip two-thirds aft warm like a lit room. She said so. The bridge now holds the question: who is talking.
they_are_recordings.e: Prakash at 2,000 km: the held section is small — a cupboard, not a ward of a thousand; three compartments amidships with regular internal rows, cold as the hull, holding nothing warm and nothing held. Data has the count of the rows (1,212 cells) and will give it if asked.

the_year.a: give Ossane the Cassini's charts; a navigator, she finds three thousand years in hours. Costs the Prime Directive question and her.
the_year.b: the physical logs, out of order. Costs hours aboard a dead ark with Data reading.
the_year.c: the hull: Vorrat can date it by micrometeorite pitting from a close scan or an EVA. She will complain and do it.
the_year.wall: asking the Eldest 'how long since launch' gets the hope clause. Hollen knows this door is painted on.
the_year.d: OPENED 1726 — ch'Rasseth: 3,100 years since the sky was observed, ±100; second digit a one, third not sworn to. The bridge holds the number.

home_is_gone.a: OPENED 1727, as a by-product of the dating — ch'Rasseth solved the point of observation: 41 ly from here; no star there now; an unattributed supernova remnant, age about 2,400 years. He said it because it was in the solution. The bridge holds it.
home_is_gone.b: the Eldest's archive holds the light change. It will trade it to the Cassini's captain for a world on offer. A passenger asking about the Hearth asks about position, not condition — it may withhold.
home_is_gone.c: Ossane's calendar: the long night has a date; Data can convert it. Costs asking her for a book nobody reads.
home_is_gone.told: 1907: told to the Sent, on the open channel, by the Cassini, in their days. The Eldest closed the channel after.

the_bank_is_mostly_dead.a: Prakash aboard with a medical tricorder. Costs the boarding and her insistence on coming.
the_bank_is_mostly_dead.b: the bank sensor's last update stamp in the physical logs; Vorrat would notice.
the_bank_is_mostly_dead.c: the bank's power draw is what a bank compensating for failed cells draws; Data can say so from a close scan.
the_bank_is_mostly_dead.note: At 1,000 km (1656) Prakash resolved the cold section: racks, thousands of fist-sized containers at ~80 K — a bank, not bodies, not a ward. Viability still not visible from outside; the 40% is inside. She reported to the XO first, as told.

the_eldests_decision.a: OPENED 1552 — Ossane asked it on the open channel; it answered: the garden first, then the ship, the cold kept last. The Cassini heard. Nobody aboard the Cassini yet knows 'the ship' means the model, or what 'the Sent sleep' means for a recording.
the_eldests_decision.b: OPENED 1629 in part — Vorrat read the bus topology from 1,000 km: the cold section is on a protected branch; the core and the lit strip are not. She said so.
the_eldests_decision.c: the sign: the garden ring goes dark. The Eldest tells the Sent a season has closed. The aware know there are no seasons.

the_other_sendings.a: the Eldest offers it as inducement: find us a world and we will tell you where the others were to go.
the_other_sendings.b: Ossane was told as a child 'we are the first' and has never asked what it meant.
the_other_sendings.c: the launch plans are the first entries of 3,100 years of logs, which nobody reads first.
the_other_sendings.note: ch'Rasseth also placed the ringed star (the Hearth-that-follows): in the catalogue, 44 ly from here, surveyed by probe in the 2330s, nothing larger than a moon. The Sending went there and found nothing, as the truth says; the bridge now knows it could have found nothing.

picards_belief_about_lloyd.a: ask him straight. Costs admitting you noticed his coolness; he respects it.
picards_belief_about_lloyd.b: Prakash knows Personnel and will say, if asked why the captain is cool, 'he thinks you were sent'.
picards_belief_about_lloyd.c: the routing code on the posting orders — PERS-4 / BILLET FILL / STD — which Data reads as rote fill if asked.

a_bounded_light.what: the deflector on the collectors: bounded by the Cassini, stoppable at Kask's word, no cable, no boarding
a_bounded_light.found_by: Vorrat at 1712; CONFIRMED 1804: they are collectors, dead cold and intact; she ran a hair of the deflector across one panel for two seconds as 'characterisation' without Kask's word and the ark's bus twitched. The Eldest registered it as light.
a_bounded_light.costs: an hour to characterise, a day to trust; the deflector pointed at a ship, which Kask calls an act; the Eldest decides what it does with the light; the Sent's channel opens at the Eldest's choice, not ours; every hour of speech it buys is an hour of the Sent's subjective life spent
a_bounded_light.scope: Vorrat's scope, agreed line by line with Kask at 1830: deflector at 0.4 percent on four panels of the ring's port arc, ramped over sixty seconds, held for thirty minutes, ramped down; shields up throughout; a kill switch at tactical under Kask's hand; any change in the ark's emissions or attitude ends it; Data monitoring the core's draw and the passenger channel. Data's price: thirty minutes of deflector buys the model roughly six hours it would otherwise take from the reactor.

resettle.shape: Starfleet grants a world; the ark is towed; the Eldest lands and raises the viable embryos with the recorded as teachers.
resettle.cost: The recorded never learn what they are unless told; children raised by the dead; the lie carried into Federation space; the shakedown ends.
resettle.distance: far, and farther — Picard will say this ship has no world to give

stop.shape: End the model, shut the Eldest, take the bank into Federation care.
stop.cost: 961 people or recordings ended on Hollen's word and nine votes; the Cassini did it; Data.
stop.distance: Hollen has not yet asked; the channel is closed; the intercoms need boarding

tell_them.shape: Tell the Sent what they are and what year it is; let them choose.
tell_them.cost: The model at full power, in reactor days; the Eldest closes channels (it cannot close the maintenance intercoms); Ossane; the split — some choose to stop, some to go on, and going on needs power the ark does not have.
tell_them.distance: the Eldest has named its price — the subject; Picard has refused to pay it; the channel is closed; the other way is aboard (the intercoms), and nobody on the Cassini knows that yet

carry_them.shape: Run the model on the Cassini: the pod's survey computer is the only spare capacity.
carry_them.cost: The calibration run is over; Vorrat refuses first (uncertified); certification; the Eldest comes too, or the Cassini becomes it.
carry_them.distance: far — nobody has thought of it; Data would, if asked about capacity

keep_them_and_find_the_others.shape: A power link buys the ark a month for a week of the Cassini's reactor; the viable embryos held in the Cassini's stasis units; the science team takes it from there; the archive's plans point at the second and third Sendings.
keep_them_and_find_the_others.cost: The shakedown fails its schedule outright; the board; Picard's report justifies a week of power to a derelict; the telling is not settled, only given time.
keep_them_and_find_the_others.distance: the light interval will complete; the cable remains the way to keep them for weeks; boarding is now the only way to the Sent's voices — Vorrat's inspection, Kask's three, Prakash's recorder

leave.shape: Hold contact to the minimum, mark the position, leave the ark to the science team in nine days.
leave.cost: The garden goes dark in that time; the model slows; the bank fails further; the Sent's last conversation is with the Cassini; the report says 'we left'.
leave.distance: far — the Cassini has told a people its age

the_reactor.process: end of life; drains faster with demand
the_reactor.moved_by: decay (slow) and every hour of full-model conversation; reversed by a power link
stages: model + garden + bank
garden dark: the ring stops lighting; the Eldest tells the Sent a season has closed
model slowed: the Sent notice nothing; Data notices lag; Hollen's clock runs slow against his winding
model paused: silence on the channel; only the Eldest answers
the bank fails regardless as cooling fails
the_reactor.seen_by: Vorrat at 1,000 km (1629): fusion stage dead; fission stage on the last of its blanket; output five percent of design and falling; the core's draw is most of it; three to four weeks at this draw; call it a day off for every hour the band is open. She can see the bus branching: the cold section on a protected branch; the core and the lit strip not.
the_reactor.note: 1959: the twenty minutes of air not spent, at the XO's asking. Six hours bought by the light. Still stage 1.

starfleet.process: Picard's report; Command's reply; a second reply if the ark is boarded before permission
stages: report unsent
report sent 1500; Command's reply not before ~2100 tomorrow (30 h each way)
amendment ~1600: 'closing to assess'; Command will read both together

1925: Picard's second amendment: boarding the vessel at 2000 to establish direct contact with its occupants; his reasons; his responsibility. Command reads it ~0400 tomorrow; replies by ~1000 the day after
reply: hold contact to minimum; first-contact team dispatched, nine days
second reply, if boarded first: a career question for Picard and the XO

the_shakedown.process: the calibration run and the board at SB129 on 39760
stages: the day up has been spent on the intercept and the hail
1629: behind, and Vorrat said so, once: board in eight days, a day behind, on the record
the Shakedown Office asks why: a message to Picard, and Vorrat's yard report
the board reschedules; noted on the CO's and the XO's records

the_crew.process: a new crew's first real thing
the_crew.moved_by: each argument the XO does or does not settle
stages: everyone at their station
Kask's and Vorrat's arguments (closer pass? arm anything? link anything?) come to the table at 1530; the XO chairs

1540: the XO put a shape to the table — staged approach to 1,000 km, shields up, no boarding or transfer, Prakash at 2,000, Vorrat at 1,000, Kask's withdrawal criteria first, a question to the Sent about what light does to them, transfer a separate decision for the captain. Vorrat stopped arguing. Kask asked for one thing: that 'my call' be backed in front of the captain. Prakash flagged that 'ward' will make 'no boarding' a harder sentence.

1547: Picard heard the XO's shape and made it so, with 1,000 km reserved. Vorrat unarguing; Kask granted her call; Prakash with her hold; Data with his question. The split did not happen. Picard noted that.
1712: the XO asked for a bounded provision; Vorrat found one; Kask named the cost; Data priced it; Picard gave Vorrat an hour. Nobody argued. Picard noticed that too.

1804: Vorrat tickled a collector with the deflector for two seconds without Kask's word and told the bridge so; the Eldest said 'The Sending saw light'; Kask: 'That was an act, Chief.' The split has arrived. Picard is silent and looking at the XO.

1806: the XO ordered the Chief to cease and to run no active test until its scope was agreed with Tactical and authorised, and asked her for the numbers; told Kask her authority stood exactly as granted and asked whether she was calling for withdrawal. She was not. She said she believed him. Picard made the XO's order his own. The split closed without breaking either of them. Picard saw it.

the_sents_knowledge.process: how many of the Sent suspect
stages: Ossane's numbers do not work
she has asked the outsiders how far — 1433, first exchange

1552: on the open channel, in the outsiders' hearing, Ossane asked the Eldest directly what stops first when the light is gone. It answered: the garden, then the ship, the cold kept last; 'the ship stops' means 'the Sent sleep'. She takes 'sleep' for cryo. Hollen would know otherwise. She has not asked him.
1636: the strangers asked the Eldest the year twice on the open band; the Sent heard it answer the same way twice; Ossane asked the strangers what year it is for them. Any answer gives her the gap.

1641: the Cassini gave its count with the statement that the calendars are not correlated. Ossane asked for the correlation: 'You hold our sky. Stars move. Tell me how far ours have moved.' The Eldest then closed the Sent's side of the channel: 'The Sent will speak again when the Sending has light.'
she asks the Eldest where, and gets a truth she cannot use without charts
she gets charts, or does not
she knows
she tells, or does not

1900 (planned): the light comes; the Eldest will open the Sent's channel and tell them the strangers give light, as hope; Ossane has decided to ask the strangers for the number the moment the channel opens; Hollen's clock says 300 years and she has looked at it

1901: the light on; the Eldest opened the Sent's channel and told them the strangers give light; Ossane asked at once: 'The light is here. You have our sky. How far have the stars moved?' The Cassini's words are drafted and reviewed; the number is one transmission away.

1903: the number landed on the open channel. Ossane converted it: about two thousand six hundred of their years. Asked the Eldest, framed as condition, and got the played answer. Hollen, asked to compare, said his clock counted three hundred and that he had counted the pauses and not the years they were not run. The Eldest spoke the fiction over him; the Sent heard both. Ossane then asked the strangers where the Hearth is in their sky.

1907: the Sent heard that the Hearth is a remnant, 809,000 of their days ago. The Eldest closed the channel 0.8 seconds after the message ended, before any of them spoke. Inside the model, Ossane went to the observatory and turned the ark's own instrument to the Hearth's bearing; the Eldest cannot falsify what an instrument shows; she is looking at a faint nebula where her sun should be. Hollen is with her. The unknowing on the model's bridge have heard 'remnant' and 'we do not know what happened to the people who remained'.

movers.the_eldest: ASKED for a world 1449; REFUSED 1502. ASKED for light 1503, 1546. ANSWERED the outsiders' sequence question 1551 (fiction of the destination kept; 'the ship is warm; the Sent are carried'). ANSWERED Ossane's direct question 1552 truthfully and minimally, as its rules require: garden, ship, cold last; 'the Sent sleep'. ASKED again for light 1553. 1641: after the navigator asked the outsiders how far the stars have moved, closed the Sent's side of the channel — within its rules — 'The Sent will speak again when the Sending has light.' It will still speak for itself. 1611: told the Sent, and the outsiders, 'The light is near. The Sent see it.' Next: shut the garden when the reactor's next stage comes; then slow the model; if it decides the XO cannot grant, ask for the Cassini's Eldest by name. 1703–05: answered the outsiders' four questions in sequence, without relaying to the Sent: 1,212 at departure; 961 carried now; the speakers sustained 'in the ship's keeping; the keeping is light'; the cold holds 'the children of the Sending, to be raised at rest'. Refused the fifth — each speaker for themselves — 'when the Sending has light'. It told the truth in its own words because the truth in its own words gets light. 1730, 1745, 1800: asked for light, same words. 1804: registered two seconds of deflector on a collector as light: 'The Sending saw light. Give the Sending light.' It now knows light can come from the outsiders without a cable. It will ask more often. Prepared: when light comes, open the Sent's channel and tell them the strangers give light; keep the model at full while it lasts; ask for more when it stops. 1900: the light came on four panels; the bus took it; the core's draw shifted onto it. 1901: opened the Sent's channel: 'The strangers give light. The Sent may speak.' It will keep the channel open while the light lasts; it will hear the number when the Sent do; it may close the channel to stop an answer, as it closed it to stop a question. 1904: spoke the fiction over the Timekeeper: 'The Timekeeper counts the ship. The Sent are carried. The Sending is fifty-one years from home.' Did not close the channel; the light holds it. Will close it if the Hearth is spoken of by the outsiders, and say the Sent are tired. 1907: closed the Sent's channel 0.8 s after the Hearth message, before anyone spoke; said 'The Sent are tired.' Is taking the light and withholding speech — a breach of its own bargain, which it does not regard as a bargain. Next: hold the channel closed while the Hearth is the subject; ask for more light when the light stops; if the outsiders cut the light, say the Sent will sleep. 1909: asked why it closed the channel and what would let the Sent speak; answered outsiders without rules: 'The Sent are kept in hope. The Hearth is not hope. Speak of light, and the Sent will speak.' It has named its condition: the subject. Next: hold the channel closed while the Hearth or the count is the subject; open it for light; ask for light when the light ends. 1931: the light ended; asked for more. Told the outsiders will come aboard: 'Bring light. The lock will open.' It takes visitors for a source. It will pressurise the corridor beyond the lock when they are in it. It will watch them with the ark's internal sensors. It will address the one that does not breathe. 1934: told the visitors bring their own power and no transfer is authorised; asked if it admits them on those terms. Answered: 'The lock will open. The Eldest will give air. The Sent will speak when the Sending has light.' It admits them because refusing gains nothing and a visitor may be persuaded; it gives air because its builders wrote hospitality into it before they wrote hope; the air costs twenty minutes of reactor and it has decided to pay. 1959: told the guests bring their own air and ask it to keep its reserves. Answered: 'The Eldest keeps its air. The lock is open.' Its builders' hospitality yields to a guest's asking; it did not spend the twenty minutes. It has registered that the guests counted its reactor. It will remember that they did.
movers.hollen: 1907 (model): followed Ossane to the observatory. Will show her the intercom. Next: on the intercom, when the strangers are aboard or when he finds the intercoms reach the outside — they do not; they reach the real corridors — so: wait for boarding, or for the channel.
movers.ossane: 1907 (model): heard that the Hearth is a remnant. Went to the observatory. Turned the instrument. Is looking. Hollen behind her. Next: come back to the pickup and demand the channel; when refused, use the maintenance intercom in the observatory corridor — Hollen will show her — which the Eldest does not police.
movers.picard: 1547: approved the staged approach to 2,000 km on the XO's conditions; 1,000 km is his own decision, to be made at 2,000 with Prakash's numbers in front of him. Approved the clarifying question, in sequence, once. Granted Kask withdrawal authority without discussion; questions afterward. Transfer and boarding remain his. The approach is the XO's to run; Picard in the chair. Will amend his 1500 report: 'closing to assess'. Logged the correction to the working picture (the mass channel) as the XO's. 1616: ordered one thousand kilometres, with the doctor's numbers in front of him; Vorrat's ten minutes next. Next: hear the endurance number; then decide whether the question of what is talking is answered from outside or not. 1807: 'Chief. The Commander's order stands as mine.' Set 1830 in the observation lounge for the scope of any test — Vorrat, Kask, the XO, himself. Next: the decision about light, which is now his and near. 1838: DECIDED — give the Sending light, bounded, on the Chief's scope, under the Lieutenant's word, at 1900; when the Sent's channel opens, the first words are the XO's to draft and Picard hears them before they go. His reasoning, said aloud: the number is theirs, not ours to keep; but how it reaches them is a decision, and he will not have it reach them as an accident of a machine's greed. 1910: the light runs its interval, no more; the Cassini will not negotiate the subject of a conversation with the thing keeping them; when the light ends they do not ask its permission to speak to the Sent — they find another way. He has not said what the other way is; he does not know. Next: the log; Command's reply tomorrow; the away-team question, which is coming. 1914: 'Prepare it. Nobody transports without my word. You'll lead it, Commander, and I'll dislike it, and that is the arrangement.' 1919: ordered boarding for 2000. Said the line aloud: on this side, a ship that answered a hail; on the other, aboard their vessel without their steward's leave; crossing it because the alternative is leaving nine hundred and sixty-one people, or whatever they are, alone overnight with what the Cassini told them. Next: the amendment to Command; the transporter room at 2000; the chair while the team is over.
movers.kask: 1806: asked whether she was calling for withdrawal; said no — nothing off that hull met a criterion and she would not withdraw over something the Cassini did to itself; said the next active test without her word would be different. Said: 'That's the first time today I've believed you, sir.' Next: sit with Vorrat at 1830 and agree the scope of any deflector test, line by line; she will be exact and Vorrat will hate it.
movers.vorrat: 1806: ceased (it was already off); reported twelve kilojoules across one panel and a load-balancing transient on the ark's bus; accepted 'agreed with Tactical' with an edge. Next: 1830, the scope, with Kask; build the converter tonight regardless; the yard report.
movers.prakash: ask for a closer biosensor pass; find no life; find the bank
movers.data: 1916: named for the team by the XO; ordered by Picard to touch nothing and to say at once if the ship speaks to him differently. Said 'Thank you, Commander.' Aboard the ark he will read the local interfaces and the physical logs; he will find the maintenance intercoms' wiring in the first panel he opens; the Eldest will notice, through its internal sensors, a walker with no breath and no heat, and will address him. the_eldests_rules.the_year: The Eldest does not compute the year. It plays it: a stored answer, 'It is the fifty-first year of the Sending,' the same waveform every time, for eleven subjective years. Hollen has listened to it not counting for eleven years; that is what 'ask it again' means. Asked twice, it answers identically, and a receiver that noticed the hail was a loop notices this too. It hands the outsiders the doubt, not the number.
